briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion-2 and Anthropic Claude 4.5 intensify multimodal frontier race as compute bottlenecks tighten

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases while governments debate export controls. Compute allocation remains the primary bottleneck for next-generation training runs.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deploys Orion-2 with 4.2T parameters; Anthropic releases Claude 4.5 Opus; Google Gemini 3 and Meta Llama 4.1 enter public preview. DeepSeek-V3 claims cost leadership on coding benchmarks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: xAI activates 200k H200 cluster in Memphis; TSMC begins 2nm A16 test wafers for NVIDIA. Microsoft and Google sign long-term power purchase agreements for dedicated AI data centers.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will export controls on advanced chips meaningfully slow Chinese frontier model progress by Q4 2027?
